senses.gloss: Śauri^1, son of Śūra = Vasudeva: I, 623; VII, 6031, 6035 (only C.); XVI, 191 (Vº, C. has Sº), 195.
Śauri^2, descendant of Śūra = Kṛshṇa Vāsudeva, q.v.
Saurī (“daughter of Sūrya (the Sun)”) = Tapatī: I, 3738 (Tº).

*Saura, adj. (“belonging to Sūrya (the Sun)”). § 417 (Yavakrītop.): III, 138, 10812 (vedasya, learnt by Arvāvasu).-§ 512 (Ghoshayātrāp.): III, 245, 14995 (sc. astraṃ, employed by Arjuna).--§ 586 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 101, 4608 (astraṃ, employed by Abhimanyu, only C.)--§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 46, 2656 (sc. mātaraḥ).--Do.^2, pl. (“worshippers of the sun”): VII, 2926.

Saurabheya, mostly pl. (ºāḥ) (“sons of Surabhi,” i.e. cattle, sg. bull): I, 4195 (sg.) = Kāmadhenuputraḥ, Nīl.); V, 5262 (ºā ivarshabhaṃ); VII, 163 (do.); VIII, 4416 (pl.); XII, 10261 (khorakaḥ Sºānāṃ), 13866 (nāgāḥ, read Sauraseyāḥ); XIII, 842 (ºgataṃ, sc. Śiva).
Saurabheyī, an Apsaras. § 250 (Arjunavanavāsap.): I, 213, 7858 (among the five Apsarases who were delivered from a curse by Arjuna).--§ 269 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 10, 394 (in the palace of Varuṇa).
Saurabheyī, mostly pl. (ºyyaḥ) (“daughters of Surabhi,” i.e. kine): XIII, 1370 (sg.), 3713, 3754.
Saurabhī (“daughter of Surabhi,” i.e. cow): I, 6120 (iva); V, 3609 (Surūpā nāma).
Sauratha, pl. (ºāḥ), a tribe or family among the Śibis. § 466 (Śibi): III, 197, ††13300 (Kapotaromāṇaṃ…ṛshabhaṃ Sºānāṃ).
